Front: How do you say there are two of you (at a restaurant)?
Back: 두 명이요. / Du myeong-iyo. / Two people.

Front: How do you order one kimchi stew politely?
Back: 김치찌개 하나 주세요. / Gimchijjigae hana juseyo. / One kimchi stew, please.

Front: How do you politely ask for water at the table?
Back: 물 좀 주세요. / Mul jom juseyo. / Some water, please.

Front: How do you politely ask for tissues?
Back: 휴지 좀 주세요. / Hyuji jom juseyo. / Some tissues, please.

Front: How do you say “I'll pay / Check, please”?
Back: 계산할게요. / Gyesanhalgeyo. / I'll pay / Check, please.
